mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, product_id as productId, quantity, created_at as createTime, updated_at as updateTime FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
